ticker_news.title: US Stocks Set To End Week Strong As Netflix Q3 Earnings Boost Optimism, Gold Hits New Highs: What's Driving Sentiment Friday?
ticker_news.description: US stocks are set to end the week on a strong note, with the Nasdaq and S&P 500 futures jumping on Friday. The positive reaction to Netflix's earnings and speeches by Federal Reserve officials are expected to drive the market sentiment.
ticker_news.author: Shanthi Rexaline

SPY.title: This Warren Buffett Index Fund Could Turn $200 per Month Into $332,000 With Practically Zero Effort
SPY.description: The article discusses the benefits of investing in an S&P 500 index fund, which Warren Buffett recommends as a simple and effective way to build long-term wealth. It highlights how consistent monthly investments of $200 in an S&P 500 index fund could potentially grow to over $332,000 over 35 years, with minimal effort.
SPY.author: Katie Brockman
